methodology: Per-state risk has two flavors. weightedNetRisk100 is the employment-weighted average across the ~325 SOC codes that have direct entries in our occupation-risk framework (covers ~50% of state employment). weightedNetRisk100Full additionally applies SOC major-group fallback risk to unscored SOCs, lifting coverage to ~95% — this is the honest headline number. The two are usually within 1-2 points of each other, but Full removes the upward bias from selectively scoring office-heavy occupations.
